The law's 'shrink the claim' prescription is however NOT fully reachable for .rodata and .sdata2 here -- see claim.law.AF_dtk-rejects-an-unaligned-auto-split-start-so-some-claim-slack-is-structural.20260903.v1. claim.law.bss-reverse-declaration-order.20260829.v1 SCREENED: the three .bss arrays keep their declaration order and the object still emits .bss 0x240 with atree_handles at 0, atree_scroll at 0x60, whichatree at 0x1E0, matching symbols.txt 0x8023CFA0/0x8023D000/0x8023D180 exactly, so no COMMON reordering occurred in either variant. claim.law.symbolified-own-pool-literal-blocks-tu-flip.20260831.v1 SCREENED and CONFIRMED as the mechanism behind the .sdata2 half: atree.c declares sAtreeZero, sAtreeFrameRoundBias and sAtreeDummyName as externs onto addresses inside its OWN .sdata2 range.
attributes.probed_form: Probe A (kept): `FatalError("NODE HAS PARENT > NODE", 0x804060);` replacing `">= NODE"`, and `return DoAnimateTree(sAtreeZero, tree, sequence, 0, last, 1);` replacing `DoAnimateTree(0.0f, ...)`. Probe B (reverted): `static const f32 sAtreeZero = 0.0f; static const f64 sAtreeFrameRoundBias = 0.5;` + `strcmp(nodeDefinition->name, "DUMMY")` -- this reproduces the target's .sdata2 layout EXACTLY (float at +0, double at +8, string at +0x10, 0x16 bytes, 100% byte-equal to the DOL at 0x80345848) but emits all three as ANONYMOUS pool entries (@166/@211/@1217), which defake_gate scores as four MOVED-AWAY-FROM-TARGET relocation regressions. Probe C (reverted): the same three as external-linkage `const` -- MWCC then emits BOTH the named objects AND folded literal copies, growing .sdata2 to 0x28. Probe D (reverted): `s32 atree_handles[24]; u8 atree_scroll[24][16]; void* whichatree[24];` without `static` -- links, but moves fn_8001267C's body.
attributes.residual: The one target datum NOT reproducible from source is the orphan double 1.0 at 0x80345840, the first entry of atree's .sdata2, which NO relocation in the target's 36 functions points at. Our own build emits exactly this shape once (an unreferenced @166 pool entry survives from the `0.0f` literal in the pinned DoAnimateTreeFrame at src/game/anim/atree.c:515), which is direct evidence for the recorded 'stripped fns still order the sdata2 pool' mechanism: the retail TU very likely carried a static helper that mwld dead-stripped while its pool entry stayed. That orphan is why the .sdata2 claim was left OFF: our object would have to start at 0x80345848, not at the section's true start.

denial.expiry_check: python tools/gdl/composed_census/wf_rederive_pin.py game/anim/atree fn_8001267C --apply after making atree_handles/atree_scroll/whichatree/natreelists non-static; the denial expires the moment that returns byte-identical body hashes, or the moment fn_8001267C closes source-exact and its rule is deleted.
denial.falsifier: A source form that gives the four symbols external linkage while leaving fn_8001267C's compiled body byte-identical to the static form (compare `python AF_scratch/af_fnbytes.py build/GUNE5D/src/game/anim/.postprocess/body/atree.o fn_8001267C` across the two variants -- the static form matches the target's `stw r31,480(r3)` / `stb r0,96(r3)` / `stwx r29,r28,r4` trio, the global form emits `stwx r31,r28,r4` / `stb r0,192(r3)` / `stw r29,96(r3)` instead). Both variants carry the SAME relocations (`.bss.0` + `@1168` + gErrorCode + natreelists), so this is a schedule/addressing choice, not a relocation difference.
denial.premise_measurement: 36/36 functions read EXACT or MATCH-* under `fndiff game/anim/atree.c --clean` and `defake_gate baseline game/anim/atree.c --at-head` reports 36 functions, 36 at real 0 (commit 47ec5953c). Data recovered and byte-verified against orig/GUNE5D/sys/main.dol: .rodata 0x17B at 0x80110780 100% equal, .data 0x60 at 0x80118128 100% equal, .bss 0x240 at 0x8023CFA0, .sbss 0x2C at 0x803441C0, .sdata2 0x16 at 0x80345848 100% equal. The flip nevertheless fails at LINK: mwldeppc reports `undefined: 'atree_handles'` and `undefined: 'atree_scroll'` referenced from pbDiagDrawInfo in pb_diag.o, and the retail pb_diag object's own relocation table (objdump -dr build/GUNE5D/obj/game/pb/pb_diag.o) carries R_PPC_ADDR16_HA/LO against atree_handles, atree_scroll and whichatree plus R_PPC_EMB_SDA21 against natreelists -- so all four are GLOBAL in retail while src/game/anim/atree.c declares them static. Removing `static` links, but the webfrank stage then aborts with `fn_8001267C: input hash 2e173292... != expected c4a10701...`, and tools/gdl/composed_census/wf_rederive_pin.py game/anim/atree fn_8001267C refuses with 'A BODY HASH MOVED: the source change altered codegen'. Measured cost of the globalization on the pre-webfrank body (`fndiff game/anim/atree.c --raw --count`): fn_8001267C real 72 -> 82, every other function unchanged (DoAnimateTreeFrame 38, fn_80011BBC 6, AtreeInitSub 38, all 32 others real 0).
denial.scope: The Object(NonMatching -> Matching) flip of game/anim/atree.c ONLY, and only while fn_8001267C is served by its webfrank rule derived against the static-linkage codegen. It denies nothing about the TU's functions, its data claims, or a later flip after the pin is re-derived.

Second-choice: re-derive the rule from scratch against the global-linkage body (575/575 instructions, real 82).
